So there's a conflict: the majority says full-time Payroll Specialist, Security says contractor with basic training.

The policy: full_time employees up to write, admin only if role owns system. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

If full-time Payroll Specialist: max admin for Payroll (since role owns system), requested write ≤ max, grant write.

If contractor with basic training: max read, requested write > max, grant read.

So the employee is a contractor with basic training, max access = read. Requested write > read, so grant read.

I'll go with read.
